svg.title: Shinrai Ou — Throne of Thunder. Draft 2 / Storm classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Mandate of Thunder forks into Vajra Tempering then Thunder King's Wrath, or Lightning Rod then Judgement from Above. Raiment of Storms forks into Galvanic Rebuke then Thunder Answers Thunder. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Storm-classified Shinrai Ou jutsu.

Its only enemy debuff is Hammer's 35% Increase Damage Taken on area enemies, which anchors the exposure route; its only defensive row is the Storm Cloak's 40% Reflect, which anchors the bulwark route. BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Thunder Answers Thunder"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has four supported tags on nine rows (Damage x4, Increase Damage Given x3, Increase Damage Taken x1, Reflect x1). The enemy-facing root (Mandate of Thunder) forks into a damage route and an exposure route; the self-facing root (Raiment of Storms) is a single Foundation -> Hidden -> Advanced chain on Reflect. Increase Damage Given is the only tag left for a fourth route, and it is deliberately not given one: two of its three rows sit on the same 40 AP Storm Cloak cast and the bloodline passive multiplies it again, so a dedicated route would either push IDG past the +5 that Taiyo Kami's doubled-row Celestial Ignition tolerates, or need a +3-primary capstone that only mirrors the Reflect capstone's secondary. A second Hidden Art under Raiment of Storms was also rejected: a +2 IDG or +2 IDT support node is dominated by Mandate of Thunder as the bulwark's fourth purchase, and a +2 Damage node would be a twin of Vajra Tempering giving a capstone-free +5 Damage route (01, 02, 06 and it), equal to Taiyo Kami's Damage ceiling and tying the Burst route's first three purchases. The consequence is that the bulwark route's fourth purchase is always Mandate of Thunder (06, 07, 08 plus 01 is legal and non-dominated), while Burst and Exposure each have two fourth-purchase choices. Three distinct complete builds exist.","design_notes":["Node split and calibration: Foundations +2/+2 (Mandate: IDG and exposure, 4 rows) and +2/+1 (Raiment: Reflect and raw power, 5 rows); Hidden Arts +2 Damage on four rows or +3 on a single-row percentage tag; capstones +3 Damage or +5 primary with a +3 IDG secondary. IDG sits only on Mandate and the capstone secondaries, so it tops out at +5 (Cloak 35/35 -> 40/40, Raijin 35 -> 40), as on Taiyo's doubled-row Celestial Ignition. Damage tops out at +6 on four rows (50/45/40/40 -> 56/51/46/46).","Main tree and passives: both Storm Cloak IDG rows match the kit's own Storm hits (row 0 via its Highest stat filter, row 2 via its Storm element), stack additively with Raijin's IDG, and the bloodline passive IDG (25 + 0.15/lvl) multiplies on top. Enhanced IDG also reaches normal jutsu and weapons in the two-round windows (Highest-stat or element-less hits for row 0 and Raijin; Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less for row 2). Hammer's exposure amplifies allies' matching hits too.","Delivery and uptime: all five jutsu have cooldown 7; the four attacks cost 60 AP, the Cloak 40 AP. Buffs and the exposure last two rounds, so staggered Cloak and Raijin casts give about four of every seven rounds of enhanced IDG, and Hammer exposes whoever its range-5 spiral catches for two rounds. Daibutsu Thunder (OTHER_USER, range 4) and Raijin (EMPTY_GROUND, range 5) are circle spawns; Divine Railgun is a single-target range-4 shot. Realized hits depend on positioning; not simulated.","Fourth-purchase choices: Burst (01, 02, 03) finishes with Lightning Rod (exposure 40%) or Raiment of Storms (Reflect 42%, Damage +6); Exposure (01, 04, 05) finishes with Vajra Tempering (Damage +2) or Raiment of Storms; Bulwark (06, 07, 08) finishes only with Mandate of Thunder (see the narrow-kit exception). Hybrids without a capstone (for example 01, 02, 04, 06 or 01, 02, 06, 07) spread +2 to +5 across all four tags and stay non-dominated.","Reflect route reasoning: the Cloak Reflect row lists all four stat types and no element, so under getEfficiencyRatio it matches effectively every hit the caster takes, pierce included, and the returned damage bypasses shield absorption. 40% -> 50% leaves ten points under the 60%-of-hit cap. Reflect only pays when the caster is hit during the window, so the bulwark is a duelist's build rather than a passive defence; the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken row to pair with it.","Untouched rows: Daibutsu Thunder's recoil 40%, Divine Railgun's stun 100 and the two move rows are unsupported tags and receive nothing; the bloodline passives (IDG and 15% Decrease Damage Taken against Lightning) are not potency targets. Skill-tree effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no node applies there."],"risks":["Classification: Storm is not exclusive in the census (Arashima and Godstorm Eclipse are INCLUDE kits with Storm damage rows; Stormboat Willy is deferred), and whether any NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT/FORBIDDEN jutsu carries Storm is unverified. The tree assumes a bloodline-scoped whole-kit classification; a bare element match would leak every node to those kits.","Resolver: 3 of the 9 supported rows (Storm Cloak IDG row 0, Storm Cloak Reflect, Raijin IDG) have no element and fall back to None under the current resolver, so they are unreachable without the proposed classification change; reaching them with affectedElements including None would also reach every element-less row on any jutsu the player casts.","IDG stacking: with both Cloak rows, Raijin and the bloodline passive active, the kit already carries roughly 105 additive points of jutsu IDG plus a multiplying passive in a full window; the +5 ceiling adds 15 more additive points across those three rows. Each row stays far below the 100 cap, but the combined per-hit amplification is high and was not simulated against peer kits.","Exposure breadth (user-owned decision, not applied): +10 lifts Hammer's area Increase Damage Taken to 45% for two rounds and amplifies allies' Storm, Lightning, Water or element-less hits (pierce excluded). It is at the +10 guardrail and above Taiyo Kami's +7 IDT ceiling. Options: Judgement from Above +3 IDT (route +8, Hammer 43%) or accept +10 as a single-row team-play tag (OPEN_DECISIONS D14).","Reflect cap and uptime: 50% leaves ten points of headroom under the 60%-of-pre-shield-damage cap, but main-tree or item Reflect sources could saturate it and waste part of the +10. Reflect pays only when the caster is hit during the two-round window and, like IDG and IDT, only on rounds after the cast round (tags.ts reflect handler: !isNew && !castThisRound); realized value was not simulated.","Open balance decision (user-owned, not applied): the Burst build (01, 02, 03, 06) puts +6 Damage on all four damage rows, row-weighted 34 against Taiyo Kami's 31 (Damage +5 on 3 rows). This is accepted under the narrow-kit exception (Nature's Blessing precedent) rather than fixed with a filler Hidden Art.","Delivery: Daibutsu Thunder (circle spawn on an OTHER_USER target), Raijin (ground circle spawn) and Hammer (spiral shoot) are area deliveries whose realized hits and exposure coverage depend on positioning; the dossier flags no ally-hazard rows (friendly fire ENEMIES on every harmful row). g.text: Draft 2 / Storm classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Shinrai Ou jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Thunder King's Wrath path + Raiment of Storms
Judgement from Above path + Vajra Tempering
Thunder Answers Thunder path + Mandate of Thunder
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · REF: Reflect
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Storm Cloak · Increase Damage Given (each of 2 effects)
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
